source_title: NBT Executive Assistant Recruitment 2026 – Walkin - FreeJobAlert.Com
source_excerpt:
National Book Trust, India (राष्ट्रीय पुस्तक न्यास, भारत), Ministry of Education, Govt. of India, will hold a walk-in interview on 2 November 2026 between 9:00 a.m. and 12.00 p.m. at the National Book Trust, India. The NBT Recruitment 2026 walk-in is for 1 post of Executive Assistant. The post is purely on a contract basis through a placement agency, with a monthly remuneration of ₹35,000 – ₹40,000. Interested candidates may attend with the prescribed application form, which is available on www.nbtindia.gov.in.
NBT Executive Assistant Walk-in Interview Date, Time and Venue
The official notification does not specify the application fee.
National Book Trust, India works under the Ministry of Education, Govt. of India. Its letterhead gives its address as 5 Institutional Area, Phase-2, Vasant Kunj, New Delhi-110070, and its phone number as 91-11-35464620. The Executive Assistant will handle noting and drafting, media coordination and reporting related to project implementation at the Trust.
National Book Trust, India has 1 Executive Assistant post. Candidates must not be above the upper age limit of 35 years. The notice does not print an "as on" date for age. The monthly remuneration is ₹35,000 – ₹40,000.
Bachelor's Degree in English Honours/Humanities from a recognised University, or any Graduate with strong English communication skills.
Diploma/Certificate in Office Administration or Secretarial Practices.
Minimum 2-3 years of experience in Office administration, filling, drafting and noting work.
Experience of working with Govt. Organizations/Public Sector undertaking/educational institution/reputed organization.
Strong proficiency in written and spoken English and Hindi.
Ability to undertake structured noting and drafting work independently.
Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the Executive Assistant post.
The notice lists these key responsibilities for the Executive Assistant:
Noting and Drafting of official correspondence, reports and documentation.
Communication and coordination with media persons through email, phone, and other official channels.
Support in administrative documentation, data management and overall reporting related to project implementation.
There is no online application. Candidates attend the walk-in interview on 2 November 2026, between 9:00 a.m. and 12.00 p.m., with the prescribed application form available on www.nbtindia.gov.in.
The prescribed application form, filled in.
Self-attested copies of all relevant certificates, degrees, testimonials etc., attached with the application.
The originals of these documents, to be shown at the time of interview.
The Executive Assistant will be engaged purely on a contract basis through a placement agency, initially for three months. The engagement can be extended as per the requirement of the Trust.
Incomplete applications will be rejected.
No T.A./D.A. will be paid for attending the interview.
Selected candidates must also produce their original documents at the time of joining.

NBT Executive Assistant Recruitment 2026 - FAQs
Q1. When is the NBT Executive Assistant walk-in interview 2026?
The walk-in interview will be held on 2 November 2026, between 9:00 a.m. and 12.00 p.m.
Q2. Where will the NBT Executive Assistant walk-in interview be held?
The walk-in interview will be held at the National Book Trust, India. Its letterhead address is 5 Institutional Area, Phase-2, Vasant Kunj, New Delhi-110070.
Q3. How many vacancies are there in NBT Recruitment 2026?
There is 1 vacancy (01 Post) for Executive Assistant under Advt. No. 138 /2026/Estt.
Q4. What qualification is needed for the NBT Executive Assistant post?
Candidates need a Bachelor's Degree in English Honours/Humanities from a recognised University, or must be a Graduate with strong English communication skills. They also need a minimum of 2-3 years of experience in office administration, filling, drafting and noting work.
Q5. What is the age limit for the NBT Executive Assistant post?
The upper age limit for the Executive Assistant post is 35 years.
Q6. What is the salary of an NBT Executive Assistant?
The monthly remuneration for the Executive Assistant post is ₹35,000 – ₹40,000.
Q7. Which documents should I bring to the NBT walk-in interview?
Bring the prescribed application form with self-attested copies of all relevant certificates, degrees and testimonials attached. You must also produce the originals at the interview.
Q8. Is the NBT Executive Assistant post permanent?
No. The engagement is purely on a contract basis through a placement agency, initially for three months. It can be extended as per the requirement of the Trust.
Q9. Will NBT pay travel allowance for attending the interview?
No. No T.A./D.A. will be paid for attending the interview.
Q10. Which languages must an NBT Executive Assistant know?
The candidate must have strong proficiency in written and spoken English and Hindi. A good knowledge of MS Office and Excel is also required.
